task.title: Prevent premature WebAR arrival and reject phone rotation as walking. [tdd:required]
task.definition_of_done: Raw estimated position controls remaining distance and arrival; path snapping is display-only within 0.55 m; arrival requires staying within 0.45 m for 1.2 s and clears beyond 0.9 m; rapid rotation does not create steps.

checks.description: Raw estimated position controls remaining distance and arrival; path snapping is display-only within 0.55 m; arrival requires staying within 0.45 m for 1.2 s and clears beyond 0.9 m; rapid rotation does not create steps.
Arrival uses raw estimated position, not its path projection
Entry dwell and exit hysteresis prevent status flicker
Rapid rotation is rejected without disabling the next real step
Persisted sessions resume from arrived to navigating and clear completion fields
Tracking pauses and sensor callback gaps reset pending arrival confirmation

reviewer_notes: Initial review found terminal-session recovery and paused-dwell issues; both were fixed before approval.
followups: Add a future database-backed service test for clearing completion fields on arrived-to-navigating updates.
